Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.internal

Class Locks

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.internal.Locks
public final class Locks extends Object
The write locks of one space. A lock covers its root, and every member below it when its depth is infinite. Not thread-safe: it is read and changed only while its Space is held. Expiry is wall-clock time, so every process sharing the space reads it alike.
